== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Dread War was a massive conflict centered on the attempt to eliminate the [[Dreadgods]], powerful entities that exist to consume the world. The war was sparked by an ambitious project to destroy these beings, which resulted in a catastrophic slaughter of the world's [[Monarchs]]. During the conflict, twelve [[Monarchs]] launched an attack against the [[Wandering Titan]]; however, the other three [[Dreadgods]] awakened to defend their kin, leading to the greatest loss of [[Monarch]] life since the creation of [[Cradle]]. The war caused immense [[destruction]], devouring vast stretches of grasslands and obliterating many great houses and families. Following the conclusion of the war, only two [[Monarchs]] remained to convene with surviving [[Heralds]] and families. In an effort to rebuild and cultivate a new generation of [[Monarchs]], these survivors organized the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]].}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The Dread War stands as a significant historical event defined by the simultaneous rampage of all four [[Dreadgods]]. This conflict marked the final instance in which the four entities acted in unison, a period that included the death of [[Emala]]. While the war is a matter of history, all four [[Dreadgods]] have recently been awakened for the first time since that era.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The [[Dread War]] is a past event involving the four [[Dreadgods]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c2">''Dreadgod'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|All four [[Dreadgods]] have been awakened for the first time since the [[Dread War]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The [[Dread War]] is a historical event.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5">''Dreadgod'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|[[Emala]] died during the [[Dread War]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7">''Dreadgod'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The [[Dread War]] was the last time all four [[Dreadgods]] rampaged at the same time.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c8">''Dreadgod'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
